name: Kulai Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun®
short_description: A half-marathon event in Kulai, Johor, Malaysia, offering 5km, 10km, and 21.1km distances on November 15, 2026.
ai_summary: The Kulai Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun® is a half-marathon event scheduled for November 15, 2026, at AEON Mall Kulaijaya in Kulai, Johor, Malaysia. Runners can choose from three distances: 5km, 10km, and the flagship 21.1km half marathon.
pros: Multiple distance options (5km, 10km, 21.1km) to suit different runner levels
Convenient venue at AEON Mall Kulaijaya, a well-known local landmark

faqs.question: When is the Kulai Half Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Kulai Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun® is scheduled to take place on November 15, 2026. This date has been confirmed for the event, which will be held at AEON Mall Kulaijaya in Kulai, Johor, Malaysia, giving runners a clear target for their training and preparation.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The event offers three distance categories for participants to choose from: a 5km run, a 10km run, and the flagship 21.1km half marathon. This range allows both casual runners and more experienced athletes to select a distance that matches their fitness level and running goals.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The Kulai Half Marathon 2026 is held at AEON Mall Kulaijaya, located in Kulai, Johor, Malaysia. This venue serves as the central hub for the race, making it a convenient and accessible location for participants traveling from within Johor and beyond.
